data.body: This page records verified behavior and gaps discovered while building the Platform manual through the Platform itself.
data.heading: Findings belong beside the workflow they affect

data.body:
Verified in this build

  • Object validation rejected invalid article annotations without persisting.
  • Taxonomy, article, section, section template, template, theme, tracking configuration, and site changes completed their governed lifecycle.
  • Product and editorial voice creation succeeded, review opened, and publish correctly refused without approval.

Open finding

A template slot schema accepts shared_ref, but live template structural validation currently reports it as an unregistered component. The documentation template was created without that slot while the validator mismatch is tracked for repair.
